rule_3_final: R23 firmware rule 3, QSPI_IO2 / PE4 bridge (R23-SAFETY-08 (1); verified Minor by round23_safety_severity_check.md). Physics: Q124's gate capacitor is C126, 220 nF, not C128 (100 nF, on the drain); the gate time constant is 47–53 µs; a steady IO2-against-PE4 fight with the MCU driving IO2 high puts 1.19–1.98 V on the gate and fires the match after about 0.55 ms in all but one modelled corner; page-program logging at a QSPI clock of 25 MHz or more stays at most 6 mA RMS, at least 50× below the 0.30 A no-fire (Calculation / Simulation; driver resistances, flash drive, the AON7524 sub-amp curve and the match thermal model are Inference); firing needs a sustained IO2-high pattern. Ground refusal: before PC1 goes high, run a QSPI quad read-verify of a known pattern, and refuse on any mismatch: the bridge corrupts quad reads. QSPI use while PC1 is high: PE2 stays in its QSPI alternate function, never a GPIO driven high; no memory-mapped or parked quad reads; no long all-ones writes at a low clock; the flash output drive is not at 100 %. Cold screen: during part of the passive cold screen, run sustained QSPI traffic and toggle PC14 and the servo PWM; refuse if CONT or BUS moves out of band. First article, before first power and coating: inspect U1 pins 1–5 for bridges, and, with the board unpowered (pack and USB disconnected), meter U3.3 (QSPI_IO2) to R127.1 (the PE4 gate network) in resistance mode, both polarities: an intact board reads above 0.9 kΩ, or open, both ways (red lead on R127.1: a diode drop plus about 0.91 kΩ through the U1 / U3 input clamps; reversed: open or slowly rising); a continuity beep or under 100 Ω in either polarity is a bridge: reject (0.91 kΩ is R127's 1 kΩ in parallel with R126 + R128, Calculation; the meter's reading through the clamps is an Inference).
rule_4_final: R23 firmware rule 4, bus voltage (R23-SAFETY-05): on the ground, after PC1 goes high and a 100 ms settle, the powered BUS must read at least 0.96 × the pack voltage derived from VLOGIC_SENSE, else refuse (this catches Q120 left off and the bus fed through its body diode). Qualify the band on first articles. Verified Minor: four stalls give 1.128 / 1.063 A (0.7 / 1.0 V drop: AONR21357 VSD typical / maximum at 1 A, p. 2; Calculation / Inference: the fire budget's hot Q124 factor is inferred), 0.93–1.01× the 1.125 A floor but at least 1.39× the maker's 0.75 A all-fire and at least 1.04× its 1.00 A recommended minimum. A first-order thermal model fires the match in 4–5 ms, inside the 20 ms pulse (Inference). At first article, before coating, with PC1 high and a dummy load in J121: ACT_GATE at R120.2 / C120.2, against Q120's source at R120.1, must settle at |VGS| of at least 4.5 V (a Q120 gate cut off from R121 sits near 0 V), and during the dummy-load fire BAT_IN − RAW_ACT above 0.2 V fails the board (R23-SAFETY-05's criterion: Q120's body diode adds 0.7–1.0 V). Since D-R24-02 each gate drive has a second barrel (Q120 (16.2, 73.3) + (15.4, 72.85), Q121 (11.14, 71.7) + (11.74, 72.3)): leaving Q120 off this way takes two opens (D-R24-19).
obligation_15_final: On VLOGIC undervoltage/shutdown drop camera EN/OE and park PD8 / PB13 / PC6 in analog mode, no pull; the GPS/radio/AUX ports stay powered whenever the battery path is on (firmware cannot switch them; off on USB-only power). J400 has no state sensor; retain the no-self-powered-port/e-match restriction. Direct port UARTs are FT digital inputs only, RX pulls always disabled; a device on J410 / J420 / J440 must drive its TX high at no more than 3.6 V, because PORT_4V8 can rise tens of ms before 3V3 (the 470 nF U11 soft-start (C85) slews VLOGIC at about 166–196 V/s after its settling time, TI SLVSEA3F Table 9-1 p. 13 scaled to 470 nF, and U2 (AP63203) starts at 3.3–3.7 V with a 4 ms soft-start, Diodes DS41326 p. 5, so 3V3 regulates about 21–26 ms into the slew; Calculation / Inference: the table is scaled linearly and the settling time is not quantified; measure the PORT_4V8-to-3V3 lag on first articles) and an FT pin allows only 4.0 V while VDD = 0 (DS12110 Rev 8 Table 119 p. 212; R20-MCU-02). ST DS12110 Rev 8 Table 122 note 3 p. 215 / Table 157 note 7 p. 247 requires pulls off above Min(VDD, VDDA, VDD33USB) + 0.3 V in operation; Table 119 note 4 p. 213 gives a separate 4 V absolute-stress condition. No powered-off isolation or positive injected current allowance.
